answer: What survives to the ember is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The mesa is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the raven. The design leans on invitation quota tree, reduced by each unverified claim, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short.
